zh.title: 背景
zh.body: 轴心军的物资状况已经接近极限。8月初，约35%的车辆正在维修；运输车辆中约85%为缴获的英国或美国车型，统一零件严重不足。约2,000辆卡车和近100门火炮仍滞留在意大利，另有大量车辆和坦克尚在德国。英军则更接近亚历山大、开罗和苏伊士的补给基地。9月1日的一段交战中，罗梅尔记述英军约以十发炮弹回应轴心军一发。

en.title: Background
en.body: Axis logistics were near their limit. In early August, about 35 percent of vehicles were under repair; roughly 85 percent of the transport fleet consisted of captured British or American types, making standard spares scarce. About 2,000 lorries and almost 100 guns remained in Italy, while many vehicles and tanks were still in Germany. The British were far closer to the supply bases at Alexandria, Cairo and Suez. During one action on 1 September, Rommel recorded roughly ten British shells answering every Axis shell.

citation.zh: 英国皇家空军空战史处《中东战役》第四卷；相关数字亦见《隆美尔战时文件》。十比一仅指隆美尔对9月1日一段交战的记述，并非整个战区的恒定比例。
citation.en: RAF Air Historical Branch, Middle East Campaigns, Volume IV; figures also reproduced from The Rommel Papers. The ten-to-one comparison is limited to Rommel's account of an action on 1 September, not presented as a theater-wide constant.

zh.title: 来自最高统帅部的口信
zh.body: 纽拉特见到了元首。元首向装甲集团军致意，并已获知罗梅尔对油料、兵力和战局的忧虑。

en.title: Message from Führer Headquarters
en.body: Neurath met the Führer. Hitler sent his greetings to the Panzer Army and had been told of Rommel's concerns about fuel, manpower and the military situation.

citation.zh: 《隆美尔战时文件》。文字仅保留已出版叙述支持的部分；未获支持的“最高统帅部期待进攻成功”说法已删去。
citation.en: The Rommel Papers. Wording is deliberately limited to the parts supported by the published account; the unsupported claim that OKW expected a successful offensive is omitted.

zh.title: 给露西的信
zh.body: “亲爱的露，目前我的处境糟透了——至少从军事上看是如此……真叫人忍不住落泪。”

en.title: Letter to Lu
en.body: “Dearest Lu, Things are going downright badly for me at the moment, at any rate, in the military sense. … It’s enough to make one weep.”

translationBasis.en: Published English translation; German wording not yet verified

citation.zh: 《隆美尔战时文件》，1942年7月17日致露西·隆美尔的信。英文摘录采用已出版英译；在德文原文核实前，中文明确标为据该英译转译。
citation.en: The Rommel Papers, letter to Lucie Rommel dated 17 July 1942. The English excerpt is the published translation. The Chinese text is explicitly marked as translated from that English edition until the German original is verified.

zh.title: 指挥层遭受损失
zh.body: 第21装甲师师长格奥尔格·冯·俾斯麦阵亡，非洲军军长瓦尔特·内林负伤。指挥计划受到严重破坏，弗里茨·拜尔莱因接掌非洲军。

en.title: Losses in the command chain
en.body: Georg von Bismarck, commander of the 21st Panzer Division, was killed, while Afrika Korps commander Walther Nehring was wounded. The command plan was badly disrupted and Fritz Bayerlein assumed command of the corps.

zh.title: 燃油没有抵达
zh.body: 承诺的油料车仍未出现。撤退所需燃油被集中调拨，车辆在照明弹下暴露于持续空袭；密集的车队成为轰炸机最容易辨认的目标，许多车辆燃烧或被毁。

en.title: The fuel has not arrived
en.body: The promised fuel lorries still did not appear. Fuel had to be concentrated for the withdrawal, while vehicles were exposed under flares to repeated air attack; the packed columns made easy targets and many vehicles burned or were destroyed.

zh.title: 山脊没有动静
zh.eyebrow: 司令部观察报告 · 1942年9月1日
zh.body: 德军等待英国坦克离开山脊。观察哨只能看见远处炮口闪光和少量侦察车辆，英军装甲主力仍保持集结。燃料储备继续下降，任何一次迂回都可能让坦克失去返回阵地的燃料。

en.title: No movement from the ridge
en.body: The Germans waited for the British tanks to leave the ridge. Observation posts saw only distant muzzle flashes and a few reconnaissance vehicles; the main British armoured force remained concentrated. Fuel reserves continued to fall, and another wide manoeuvre could leave the panzers without enough fuel to return.
